The Decade

Site file

The altar comes first

The sanctuary begins as a small plot of land, bounded by horos stones and centered on an altar. The plot contains two springs, an old oak, and rising ground to the north. Select a building card and click a valid site to start construction; large buildings take many years to complete. Set the festival policy, then advance the decade. Click any built structure to inspect or upgrade it.

Ash altar of Zeus, Olympia — built up over centuries from sacrificial ash (Paus. 5.13.8–11).

Build

A work is paid for as it goes up: three-tenths down, the rest by the year, and a tenth held until the work is approved. Upkeep is charged per year.

Chronicle

Pedagogical sanctuary simulator rev. kinetos
Temenos

Found the sanctuary

You direct the board of hieropoioi, the officials that a community appoints to manage festivals and sanctuaries. Your first decision is which god you want to dedicate your new sanctuary to. Several of the gods have multiple variants to choose from as well. Large buildings are paid for by patrons, and patrons expect something in return.
